chunks: Certainly, prayer drops out sins like the dropping of leaves (of trees), and removes them as ropes are removed from the necks of cattle. The Messenger of Allāh - the peace and blessing of Allāh be upon him and his descendants - likened it to a hot bath situated at the door of a person who bathes in it five times a day. Will then any dirt remain on him?

key_terms.إِطْلاَقَ الرِّبَق: as ropes are removed from the necks

ai.seo_question: How does prayer remove sins according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this passage from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (AS) elaborates on the efficacy of *Salat* by employing vivid metaphors of leaves falling and ropes being untied to illustrate the complete removal of sins. He further compares the believer to a person bathing five times daily in a hot bath (*al-hammah*), emphasizing that just as physical dirt is washed away, regular prayer purifies the soul from spiritual impurities. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of prayer not merely as ritual, but as a continuous mechanism for spiritual cleansing and moral refinement.
